messages:
Alex: Morning — I need to swap part of my Sunday oncall. I'm covered for the overnight but need someone to take Sun 07:00–11:00 UTC (4h) so I can handle a personal appointment. Non-incident FYI: infra team scheduled a reboot Sun 09:00 UTC that may cause short connection blips; details in ops-bot msg below.

Mira: I can pick up 07:00–09:00 UTC if that helps. Not great around 09:00 unfortunately. :handshake:

Jordan: I can do 09:00–11:00 UTC, happy to take over after Mira. That covers the whole chunk if you stitch us together. :thumbsup:

Alex: Perfect — thanks Mira/Jordan. I'll update the roster. Quick handoff notes — please skim: 
```
- Current alerts: none active, last paging trend normal
- Known risk window: infra reboot Sun 09:00 UTC (expected 3-5m network/connection blip). If pages spike, prefer graceful handling (increase retry backoff) vs mass escalation.
- Running jobs to watch: nightly-embeddings (starts 08:45 UTC), small chance of queue backlog post-reboot
- Runbooks: https://runbook/internal/oncall -> 'reboot-induced-paging' + standard escalation
- Contact on-call infra lead: @Sam if reboot goes wrong
```

Mira: noted. I can monitor nightly-embeddings start and catch any repeated 503s then hand over to Jordan for the post-09:30 cleanup.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance: infra-reboot on 2026-03-22 09:00 UTC. Expected downtime: brief (3-5 minutes). Auto-alert suppression will be active for 09:00–09:10 UTC.

Sam: tagging in case reboot runs long — I'll be reachable and can join if pages escalate. Also: quick heads-up, we're running low on spare GPU capacity in eu-west, but the reboot shouldn't affect capacity allocation for hosted customers.

Jordan: got it. I'll be online 09:00–11:30 UTC in case we need extra time for backlog. If Mira sees retries, prioritize ticketing over noisy escalations.

Alex: Thanks all — I'm updating the oncall calendar: 
- Mira: 07:00–09:00 UTC (covers pre-reboot)
- Jordan: 09:00–11:00 UTC (covers reboot + immediate aftermath)
I owe you both donuts next week. :donut: If anything changes I’ll ping here.

Mira: sweet, thanks. Can someone add a short note on the calendar entry about the reboot and the runbook link?

Jordan: done. Calendar note includes ops-bot link + runbook.

Alex: closing loop — thanks team. I'll hand off a brief slack DM to each of you 30m before your block as a reminder.

Sam: Thanks — standby. :white_check_mark:
